runs.label: 0. Control: nothing (top-k, no aux loss)
runs.description: sparse top-k from step 0 with no collapse mitigation at all

strategy.name: none
strategy.label: 0. Control: nothing (top-k, no aux loss)
strategy.description: sparse top-k from step 0 with no collapse mitigation at all

runs.label: 1. Auxiliary load-balancing loss
runs.description: top-k from step 0, aux loss alpha=0.01 added to the task loss

strategy.name: aux
strategy.label: 1. Auxiliary load-balancing loss
strategy.description: top-k from step 0, aux loss alpha=0.01 added to the task loss

runs.label: 2. Epsilon-greedy exploration outside the top-k
runs.description: no aux loss; sparse top-k from step 0, epsilon annealed 0.6->0.01 over 60% of the remaining steps; an exploring token is routed to k distinct experts drawn from outside its top-k and gated at a fixed temperature 4

strategy.name: explore
strategy.label: 2. Epsilon-greedy exploration outside the top-k
strategy.description: no aux loss; sparse top-k from step 0, epsilon annealed 0.6->0.01 over 60% of the remaining steps; an exploring token is routed to k distinct experts drawn from outside its top-k and gated at a fixed temperature 4

runs.label: 3. Gradient accumulation x8
runs.description: no aux loss; gradients accumulated over 8 micro-batches before each optimiser step

strategy.name: accum
strategy.label: 3. Gradient accumulation x8
strategy.description: no aux loss; gradients accumulated over 8 micro-batches before each optimiser step

runs.label: 4. Straight-through estimate of the unevaluated experts
runs.description: no aux loss, no exploration; the E-k experts top-k skipped are estimated as c*p_j from a least-squares fit of output against probability over the k that ran, wired in straight-through (alpha=1.0) so the forward pass stays exactly top-k while every router logit receives gradient

strategy.name: surrogate
strategy.label: 4. Straight-through estimate of the unevaluated experts
strategy.description: no aux loss, no exploration; the E-k experts top-k skipped are estimated as c*p_j from a least-squares fit of output against probability over the k that ran, wired in straight-through (alpha=1.0) so the forward pass stays exactly top-k while every router logit receives gradient

runs.label: 5. Dense fallback where the router is not confident
runs.description: no aux loss, no exploration; a token whose top-k experts hold less than the threshold of the router's probability mass goes through every expert instead, threshold 0.8->0 over 80% of training

strategy.name: conf
strategy.label: 5. Dense fallback where the router is not confident
strategy.description: no aux loss, no exploration; a token whose top-k experts hold less than the threshold of the router's probability mass goes through every expert instead, threshold 0.8->0 over 80% of training

runs.label: 6. Threshold selection instead of top-k
runs.description: no aux loss, no exploration; every expert above 1->1.6 uniform shares (1/E) is selected, so the count varies per token, rising over 80% of training. Unlike the others this is the routing rule at evaluation too

strategy.name: threshold
strategy.label: 6. Threshold selection instead of top-k
strategy.description: no aux loss, no exploration; every expert above 1->1.6 uniform shares (1/E) is selected, so the count varies per token, rising over 80% of training. Unlike the others this is the routing rule at evaluation too
